title: Potential energy reference level

Incorrect, because the chosen zero level is arbitrary; only the change in potential energy matters physically.
Correct, because gravitational potential energy cannot be negative.
Incorrect, because gravitational potential energy is independent of height.

title: Conservation of mechanical energy

Its kinetic energy increases while its potential energy decreases by an equal amount.
Its total mechanical energy increases as its speed increases.
Its potential energy is converted entirely into heat.

title: Power and the same amount of work
question: Two motors perform exactly the same amount of useful work. Motor P takes half the time taken by motor Q. Which conclusion follows?

P has half the useful power output of Q.
Both have equal useful power because the work is equal.
P must have twice the efficiency of Q.

options.text: It decreases because the vehicle has less time to accelerate.
It remains constant because the force is constant.
It increases because power equals force multiplied by speed when the force is parallel to motion.
It becomes zero when the vehicle's acceleration is constant.
